message.content:
Simplify the Zip Code Add/Edit forms and table in the Pinzo app at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`. Read CLAUDE.md first, then read the full file.

## What to change

The current zip code forms have 8 fields per zip code (Zip Code, Zone, Status, Message, ETA, Label, COD, Return Policy). This is too many — ETA, COD, messages, return policy belong on **Delivery Rules** (zone-level config), not per-zip-code.

### Simplify to 3 fields:

**Add Zip Code modal** — Keep only:
1. **Zip Code** (required) — text field
2. **Zone** — text field (optional, for grouping)
3. **Status** — select (Allowed/Blocked)

Remove from the Add modal:
- Message field
- ETA field
- Label field
- COD Available select
- Return Policy textarea

Add an info Banner at the bottom of the simplified form:
```
💡 Where do delivery details live?
ETA, COD, and custom messages are set on Delivery Rules attached to this zone — 
not on individual zip codes. This keeps your data clean and lets you update 
100 zip codes at once.
```

**Edit Zip Code modal** — Same 3 fields:
1. **Zip Code** (required)
2. **Zone** — text field  
3. **Status** — select (Allowed/Blocked)

Also add the **Active/Inactive** toggle (keep this since it's a per-zip operational control):
4. **Active** — select (Active/Inactive)

Add the same info Banner.

Remove from Edit modal: Message, ETA, Label, COD, Return Policy fields.

### Simplify the IndexTable columns:

**Current columns**: Zip Code, Zone, Status, Message, ETA, COD, Actions (7 columns)

**New columns**: Zip Code, Zone, Status, Actions (4 columns)

Remove columns: Message, ETA, COD

### Clean up state variables:

Remove these state variables that are no longer used in the modals:
- `newMessage`, `setNewMessage`
- `newEta`, `setNewEta` 
- `newLabel`, `setNewLabel`
- `newCodAvailable`, `setNewCodAvailable`
- `newReturnPolicy`, `setNewReturnPolicy`
- `editMessage`, `setEditMessage`
- `editEta`, `setEditEta`
- `editLabel`, `setEditLabel`
- `editCodAvailable`, `setEditCodAvailable`
- `editReturnPolicy`, `setEditReturnPolicy`

### Clean up the action handler:

In the `action` function, the `add` and `update` intents currently read all 8 fields from FormData. Simplify to only read: zip, zone, type (for add) and zip, zone, type, isActive (for update).

**IMPORTANT**: Do NOT remove the database columns from Prisma schema. The ZipCode model still has these fields for backward compatibility and existing data. Just stop reading/writing them from the form. The API (`api.zip-check.tsx`) still reads `message`, `eta`, `codAvailable`, `returnPolicy` from the zip code record — that's fine, existing data continues to work.

### Clean up the CSV import:

The CSV import section references many fields. Keep backward compatibility — if a CSV has message/ETA/COD columns, still import them. But simplify the CSV format documentation shown in the UI to only mention the 3 essential columns.

### Help text updates:

- Zip Code: "Enter a zip / pin / postal code"
- Zone: "Choose the zone this zip code belongs to (optional)"
- Status: "Whether this zip code is allowed or blocked"

## RULES
- Read CLAUDE.md
- Use Polaris v13 only
- Do NOT modify prisma/schema.prisma (keep DB columns)
- Do NOT modify api.zip-check.tsx (it still reads all fields)
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` after changes

1	# Pinzo — Shopify App Project Brain
2	
3	## Stack (Exact Versions)
4	- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
5	- **UI:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`) — use ONLY Polaris components, never raw HTML for layout
6	- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4 — for all Shopify admin UI interactions
7	- **Auth:** `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)` — required before every Shopify API call
8	- **Database:** Prisma v6 + SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
9	- **Language:** TypeScript everywhere — zero plain `.js` files allowed
10	- **Bundler:** Vite v6
11	- **Node:** ≥20.19
12	
13	## Folder Structure
14	```
15	app/
16	  routes/           ← All file-based routes
17	  billing.server.ts ← Billing/subscription logic
18	  db.server.ts      ← Prisma client singleton
19	  plans.ts          ← Pricing plan definitions (Free/Pro/Ultimate)
20	  shopify.server.ts ← Shopify auth + API setup
21	  root.tsx          ← Root component
22	  entry.server.tsx  ← Server entry
23	prisma/
24	  schema.prisma     ← Database schema
25	  migrations/       ← Migration history
26	.claude/
27	  settings.json     ← Shared permissions config
28	  commands/         ← Slash commands (/feature, /fix, /review)
29	  agents/           ← Specialized agents (builder, bug-fixer)
30	```
31	
32	## Database Models (Prisma)
33	- **Session** — Shopify OAuth session storage (do NOT modify)
34	- **ZipCode** — shop, zipCode, label, zone, message, eta, type (allowed/blocked)
35	- **DeliveryRule** — shop, name, zone, zipCodes, minOrderAmount, deliveryFee, freeShippingAbove, estimatedDays, cutoffTime, daysOfWeek, priority
36	- **WaitlistEntry** — shop, email, zipCode, note, status (waiting/notified/converted)
37	- **WidgetConfig** — shop, position, colors, heading, placeholder, buttonText, messages, borderRadius, customCss
38	- **Subscription** — shop, planId, billingInterval, shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt
39	
40	## Route Patterns
41	| Route Pattern | Purpose |
42	|---|---|
43	| `app._index.tsx` | Dashboard |
44	| `app.*.tsx` | Admin pages (require authenticate.admin) |
45	| `api.*.tsx` | Public API endpoints (storefront widget) |
46	| `webhooks.*.tsx` | Webhook handlers |
47	| `auth.*.tsx` | OAuth flow (do NOT modify) |
48	
49	## Architecture Rules
50	1. **Auth first** — always call `authenticate.admin(request)` before any Shopify API usage
51	2. **Loaders/actions only** — Shopify API calls ONLY inside loaders and actions, never inside components
52	3. **Polaris only** — use ONLY Polaris v13 components for all UI inside `app.*` routes
53	4. **Public APIs** — `api.*` routes serve the storefront widget (no auth required, return JSON)
54	5. **Webhooks** — handle idempotently, return 200 quickly, no heavy processing inline
55	6. **DB access** — import `db` from `~/db.server` for all Prisma operations
56	7. **Billing** — use `billing.server.ts` for all subscription checks and plan changes
57	8. **Plans** — reference `plans.ts` for plan IDs and feature flags
58	
59	## UI Rules (Polaris v13)
60	- Layout: `Page`, `Layout`, `Layout.Section`, `Card`, `BlockStack`, `InlineStack`
61	- Data: `DataTable`, `IndexTable`, `ResourceList`
62	- Forms: `Form`, `FormLayout`, `TextField`, `Select`, `Checkbox`
63	- Feedback: `Toast` for user-facing errors and success, `Banner` for persistent alerts
64	- Loading: `SkeletonPage`, `SkeletonBodyText`, `SkeletonDisplayText` — always add loading states
65	- Modals: `Modal` component with `active` prop
66	- Navigation: use App Bridge `useNavigate` for in-app navigation
67	
68	## Code Rules
69	- Fix ALL TypeScript errors before marking anything done — run `npm run typecheck`
70	- Error handling on every async operation (try/catch in actions/loaders)
71	- Never use raw `fetch()` for Shopify API — use the graphql client from `authenticate.admin()`
72	- Before writing new code: read 2-3 existing similar route files and match their exact pattern
73	- No `any` types — use proper TypeScript types or infer from Prisma
74	- `useActionData`, `useLoaderData` for data in components — never fetch inside components
75	
76	## Commands
77	```bash
78	npm run dev          # Start dev server via Shopify CLI
79	npm run build        # Build for production
80	npm run typecheck    # TypeScript validation (run after every change)
81	npm run lint         # ESLint check
82	npm run setup        # Prisma generate + migrate (first time)
83	npx prisma studio    # Visual DB browser
84	npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>   # Create new migration
85	npx shopify app deploy                  # Deploy to Shopify
86	```
87	
88	## When Building a Feature — Always Follow This Order
89	1. Read CLAUDE.md (this file) — understand rules
90	2. Read 2-3 existing similar route files (e.g. `app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app.settings.tsx`)
91	3. Build the route file: `loader` (fetch data) + `action` (handle mutations) + default export component
92	4. Use only Polaris v13 for all UI
93	5. Add error handling in action with try/catch, return errors via `json()`
94	6. Add loading states with Polaris Skeleton components
95	7. Run `npm run typecheck` — fix every error before finishing
96	8. List all files created and what to test
97	
98	## Existing Feature Reference
99	- ZIP code CRUD → `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
100	- Delivery rules → `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`
101	- Waitlist viewer → `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
102	- Widget config → `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`
103	- Billing/pricing → `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx` + `app/billing.server.ts`
104	- Settings → `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`
105	- Public ZIP API → `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`
106	- Public widget config API → `app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`
107	- Waitlist signup API → `app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`

# Plan: Simplify ZIP Code Add/Edit Forms and Table in Pinzo

## Goal
Reduce the Add/Edit modals from 8 fields to 3 (Add) / 4 (Edit), remove 3 table columns (Message, ETA, COD), clean up unused state, and simplify the action handler and CSV format docs.

---

## Files to Modify
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — only this file

## Files NOT to Modify
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — keep all DB columns
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — still reads message/eta/codAvailable/returnPolicy
- Any other file

---

## Change Map (in order of appearance in the file)

### 1. `downloadSampleCsv()` function (line 74–88)
Change the CSV header and sample rows to only document the 3 essential columns.

Before:
```
"Zip Code,Zone,Status,Message,ETA,COD,Return Policy",
"10001,Manhattan,allowed,We deliver here! Estimated 2-3 days.,2-3 days,Yes,30-day returns accepted",
"90210,Beverly Hills,allowed,Same day delivery available.,1 day,No,",
"33101,Miami,blocked,Sorry we do not deliver to this area.,,",
```

After:
```
"Zip Code,Zone,Status",
"10001,Manhattan,allowed",
"90210,Beverly Hills,allowed",
"33101,Miami,blocked",
```

---

### 2. `action` — `add` intent (lines 118–182)
Keep reading: `zipCode`, `zone`, `type`
Remove reading: `label`, `message`, `eta`, `codAvailable`, `returnPolicy`
In the `db.zipCode.create()` call, remove those fields (they'll default to null/undefined in DB).

---

### 3. `action` — `update` intent (lines 198–246)
Keep reading: `id`, `zipCode`, `zone`, `type`, `isActive`
Remove reading: `label`, `message`, `eta`, `codAvailable`, `returnPolicy`
In the `db.zipCode.update()` call, remove those fields from the `data` object.

---

### 4. State variables — remove 10 unused vars (lines ~646–665)
Remove:
- `newMessage`, `setNewMessage`
- `newEta`, `setNewEta`
- `newLabel`, `setNewLabel`
- `newCodAvailable`, `setNewCodAvailable`
- `newReturnPolicy`, `setNewReturnPolicy`
- `editMessage`, `setEditMessage`
- `editEta`, `setEditEta`
- `editLabel`, `setEditLabel`
- `editCodAvailable`, `setEditCodAvailable`
- `editReturnPolicy`, `setEditReturnPolicy`

---

### 5. `handleAdd` callback (lines 802–816)
Remove these `fd.set()` calls: `label`, `message`, `eta`, `codAvailable`, `returnPolicy`
Update the dependency array to remove those vars.

---

### 6. `handleOpenEdit` callback (lines 836–850)
Remove: `setEditLabel`, `setEditMessage`, `setEditEta`, `setEditCodAvailable`, `setEditReturnPolicy`

---

### 7. `handleUpdate` callback (lines 852–868)
Remove: `fd.set("label", ...)`, `fd.set("message", ...)`, `fd.set("eta", ...)`, `fd.set("codAvailable", ...)`, `fd.set("returnPolicy", ...)`
Update the dependency array to remove those vars.

---

### 8. `useEffect` success handler (lines ~998–1008 for "added" branch)
Remove: `setNewLabel("")`, `setNewMessage("")`, `setNewEta("")`, `setNewCodAvailable("")`, `setNewReturnPolicy("")`

---

### 9. `IndexTable` headings (lines ~1541–1549)
Before: `Zip Code, Zone, Status, Message, ETA, COD, Actions` (7)
After: `Zip Code, Zone, Status, Actions` (4)

Remove from headings array: `{ title: "Message" }`, `{ title: "ETA" }`, `{ title: "COD" }`

---

### 10. `IndexTable.Row` cells (lines ~1571–1653)
Remove these `IndexTable.Cell` blocks:
- The Message cell (shows `z.message || "—"`)
- The ETA cell (shows `z.eta || "—"`)
- The COD cell (shows the COD badges)

---

### 11. Add Modal — remove fields, add info Banner (lines ~1664–1824)
Modal `onClose` and `secondaryActions` cancel handler: remove `setNewLabel`, `setNewMessage`, `setNewEta`, `setNewCodAvailable`, `setNewReturnPolicy` resets.

Inside the modal body, remove:
- `TextField` for Message
- `TextField` for ETA (inside InlineStack with Label)
- `TextField` for Label (inside same InlineStack)
- `Select` for COD Available
- `TextField` for Return/Exchange Policy

Update help text:
- Zip Code helpText: `"Enter a zip / pin / postal code"`
- Zone helpText: `"Choose the zone this zip code belongs to (optional)"`
- Status helpText (allowed only plan): stays as is; otherwise `"Whether this zip code is allowed or blocked"`

Add at the bottom of the modal body (above the upgrade Banner if present), a new info Banner:
```tsx
<Banner tone="info">
